kjv: he (the Advocate) will reprove the world of sin
mine: he (the Advocate) will convict the world concerning sin
note: elencho is to expose and convict, as in a court; "reprove" weakens the forensic sense of the Advocate's work.

kjv: and ye shall see me (Jesus), because I go to the Father
note: TR adds "because I go to the Father" from 16:17; absent from P5, P66, Sinaiticus, B, D, W.
